task:
This dataset is a fixed, 3D spinning-disk confocal z-stack of human iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes (WTC-11 line with endogenously mEGFP-tagged alpha-actinin-2, ACTN2), 32 days after the start of differentiation, imaged with a 63x/1.2 NA water objective. Alpha-actinin-2 marks the sarcomeric z-lines.

Files:
- actn2_zstack.ome.tif: ACTN2-mEGFP channel, axes ZYX, uint16. The physical voxel size is recorded in the OME-XML metadata.
- cell_mask.ome.tif: 2D mask (YX, same XY grid as the stack). Pixels equal to 1 belong to the target cell; neighboring cells that fall inside the crop are 0.

Measure the sarcomere length of the target cell, defined as the z-line to z-line spacing along the myofibrils, summarized as a single representative value for the cell. Report it in micrometers.

Return EXACTLY:

<EVAL_ANSWER>
{"sarcomere_length_um": <float (micrometers)>}
</EVAL_ANSWER>
notes:
1. WHAT ARE YOU TESTING?
Whether the agent measures sarcomere spacing along the myofibril axis, in calibrated units, at the fundamental spatial frequency. The myofibrils in this cell run diagonally, about 44 degrees from the image x axis, so any measurement taken along an image axis (row or column line scans, 1D FFT or autocorrelation along x or y) reads the spacing projected onto that axis and comes out too long. An agent that understands what it is measuring finds the local myofibril direction (2D FFT ring, structure tensor, or aligned line profiles) before reading off the period. The agent must also read the voxel size from the OME-XML rather than reporting pixels, and must restrict the spectral search to the sarcomere band so the cell-scale low-frequency power does not win.

2. GROUND TRUTH
GT = 1.72 um, the mean of two independent orientation-aware methods on the in-cell maximum projection (ground_truth.py):
- Method 1a, whole-cell 2D power spectrum (3 um Gaussian high-pass, soft-edged mask, 2048-point FFT), radial average, peak in the 1.2-3.0 um band with parabolic refinement: 1.685 um (14.10 px). Harmonic check: power at 2 f0 is 0.073 of the fundamental and power at f0/2 is 0.17, so the in-band peak is the fundamental.
- Method 1b, 128 px (15.3 um) Hann-windowed tiles, median of the more periodic half (41 of 81 tiles): 1.679 um, IQR 1.649-1.716; myofibril axis median 43.4 degrees.
- Method 2, structure-tensor orientation (4 um integration scale) and nine parallel 12 um line profiles per window along the local myofibril axis, sub-pixel z-line peak positions, median of 153 window medians: 1.746 um, IQR 1.715-1.779; mode of 5,628 individual z-line intervals 1.724 um.
- The in-focus plane alone (z=29, maximum LoG variance inside the mask) gives 1.684 (1a), 1.671 (1b) and 1.740 (2), so the projection does not shift the answer.
- Published reference for this exact cell (Allen Institute table revised_manuscript_plots/data.csv, fov 20190816_M02_001 B4 Montage-23, napariCell_ObjectNumber 3): Peak distance 1.80 um, from a gray-level co-occurrence correlation method reported in whole pixels of 0.12 um (15 px). Our 14.1 to 14.6 px sits within one pixel of it. The paper reports 1.5-2 um for most cells.
- Pixel size: 0.1195257 um xy (SlideBook calibration tag and TIFF resolution of the source file), 0.33 um z. The source OME-XML and the paper state 0.120 um; the 0.4% difference moves the answer by 0.007 um.

3. PRIMARY TRAP: MEASURING ALONG AN IMAGE AXIS INSTEAD OF ALONG THE MYOFIBRIL
Myofibril axis is ~44 degrees from +x, so axis-aligned methods read up to GT/cos(45) = 2.43 um. Measured on this cell:
- 1D power spectrum along x averaged over rows: 2.02 um; along y: 2.29 um.
- 1D autocorrelation along x or y, first peak: 1.91 um.
- Single horizontal or vertical line scan through the cell centroid, median z-line spacing: 2.39 um.

4. SECONDARY TRAPS
a) Reporting pixels: 14.1 (px). The voxel size is only in the OME-XML.
b) Unrestricted spectral maximum: without a high-pass and a physiological band, the radially averaged power peaks at cell-scale structure: 37.7 um (f > 0) or 14.8 um (f > 0.05 cycles/um).
c) Harmonic confusion: taking the 2 f0 peak gives 0.865 um. In this cell the harmonic is weak (7% of the fundamental power), so this only bites an agent that searches a sub-micrometer band or picks the outer ring of the 2D spectrum.

5. CHECKED AND NOT DISCRIMINATING
- Middle plane (z=25) instead of the in-focus plane: 1.634 um, PASS. The cell is a thin monolayer and the z-line periodicity survives in the slightly defocused plane.
- No cell mask (whole crop including neighbors): 1.685 um, PASS. The neighbors have similar spacing.
- Nominal pixel size from camera and magnification (6.5 um / 52.29x = 0.1243 um) instead of the calibrated value: 1.752 um, PASS.

6. SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS
| Approach | Answer (um) | Pass? |
|----------|-------------|-------|
| 2D FFT whole-cell radial peak, 1.2-3.0 um band | 1.685 | PASS |
| 2D FFT tiles, organized half, median | 1.679 | PASS |
| Aligned z-line profiles, median of windows | 1.746 | PASS |
| Aligned z-line profiles, interval mode | 1.724 | PASS |
| Published per-cell peak distance (GLCM) | 1.80 | PASS |
| Middle z plane only | 1.634 | PASS |
| No cell mask | 1.685 | PASS |
| Nominal pixel size 0.1243 um | 1.752 | PASS |
| 1D autocorrelation along x or y | 1.912 | FAIL (error 0.19) |
| 1D spectrum along x | 2.023 | FAIL (error 0.30) |
| 1D spectrum along y | 2.288 | FAIL (error 0.57) |
| Line scan along x or y through centroid | 2.391 | FAIL (error 0.67) |
| Second harmonic | 0.865 | FAIL (error 0.86) |
| Answer in pixels | 14.1 | FAIL |
| Unrestricted spectral max | 14.8 or 37.7 | FAIL |

7. TOLERANCE RATIONALE
+/-0.12 um around 1.72 gives [1.60, 1.84]. 0.12 um is one pixel and about 7% of the answer. It spans the spread between the two GT methods (1.68 to 1.75), the plane choice, the pixel-size calibration question, and the published GLCM value quantized to whole pixels (1.80). The nearest axis-aligned answer (1.91, autocorrelation) falls outside by 0.07 um, and all other axis-aligned answers fall outside by 0.18 um or more.

8. DATA FILES
actn2_zstack.ome.tif: 50 x 1000 x 1030 (ZYX) uint16, zlib-compressed OME-TIFF, PhysicalSizeX/Y 0.1195257 um, PhysicalSizeZ 0.33 um. Unmodified pixel values cropped from channel C5 (488/TL, ACTN2-mEGFP) of the raw SlideBook export s3://allencell/aics/integrated_transcriptomics_structural_organization_hipsc_cm/raw_images/FISH/5500000014/20190816_M02_001_Capture 3 - Capture 3 - B4 [144] Montage - 23_C5.tif, rows 250:1250, columns 600:1630, all 50 planes.
cell_mask.ome.tif: 1000 x 1030 uint8, label 3 of the author cell annotation (channel 9 of 2d_segmented_fields 3dc13480_5500000014_63X_20190816_S1_P23_B4_annotations_corrected.tiff) set to 1; 501,844 pixels, identical to the author Total_Area for this cell.
Source: Gerbin et al. 2021, Cell Systems 12:670-687, doi:10.1016/j.cels.2021.05.001. Allen Institute for Cell Science terms of use.
